title: jired report issues result
description: How many issues, broken down by one field, or by two as a matrix. An issue with several values for a field (the sprints it has been in, its labels, its fix versions) counts once under each, the way JQL's `sprint = X` matches; every total counts each issue once.

by.description: The rows' field, then the columns' field when there are two

source.description: `workspace`: the working copy's files, offline. `server`: the issues `jql` found

columns.description: The second field's values, in column order; empty for one field

rows.description: One per value of the first field, in natural order (`Sprint 9` before `Sprint 10`), `(none)` last for the issues with no value

counts.description: Per column, the issues in this cell; empty for one field. A column with none is absent

total.description: Issues in this row, each once

totals.description: Per column, the issues in it, each once; empty for one field
